requalification.machinery_fix: write_revision_artifact_index.py: added revision_requalification_supersession_ledger.v1.json and revision_requalification_supersession_receipt.v1.json to VOLATILE_QUALIFICATION_RECEIPTS. These are written by revision_supersession AFTER the index is built and record the old->new index transition (their new_artifact_index_sha256 is the index itself). The prior (first) requalification only succeeded because they did not pre-exist at rebuild time. On this SECOND requalification they already existed, so a naive re-index folded in their pre-supersession hashes and supersession's rewrite then made the index stale (BLOCKED_REVISION_HASH_MISMATCH at prepare). Excluding them -- exactly like the prepare/verify/activation receipts already excluded -- makes build_index idempotent across repeat requalifications. They remain on disk and in the append-only ledger; only their hashes are omitted from the index.

current_blocker.root_cause: The run is voiced (one spoken Kai line in sb_003), so audio_strategy_gate.assess_and_block_kling_request requires a valid phase_11_submit_return/preflight/voice_handoff_plan.json BEFORE build_payload_binding will produce the payload binding. This audio-strategy gate was ADDED after the frozen predecessor's original phase-11 compile (gate introduced in commit c870698c 2026-07-17 14:15; predecessor phase11_live_request.v1.json compiled at 09:56 in commit d6d869c3, before the gate existed), so the predecessor never faced it and the prior media-binding blocker receipt did not map it.
circular_dependency: run.sh bootstrap-phase11-payload-binding -> build_payload_binding -> _audio_strategy_gate REQUIRES a present+valid voice_handoff_plan.json (voice_handoff_present must be true).

scripts/write_voice_handoff_plan.py REQUIRES phase_11_submit_return/canonical/phase11_live_request.v1.json to exist (it reads approval_bindings.request_body_sha256 from it). Confirmed: the ONLY missing input is that compiled canonical; transcript, kai_voice_audition.json, shot_bible.json, and the ambient WAV are all present, and NO live voice render is needed (the voice binding reuses the existing kai_voice_audition.json).
scripts/compile_phase11_canonical_live_request.py REQUIRES the payload binding (--candidate-binding, the bootstrap output) to compile the canonical request.
capture_phase11_provider_source_snapshot.py and every other downstream phase-11 step also require the payload binding first (confirmed: returns BLOCKED_PHASE11_PAYLOAD_BINDING_MISSING).

=> voice_handoff_plan needs the compiled request; the compiled request needs the payload binding; the payload binding needs the voice_handoff_plan. No sanctioned linear order can start for a voiced run.
current_blocker.no_gpu_render_required: Breaking the cycle needs only the DETERMINISTIC request_body_sha256 (the request body is deterministic given the media binding URLs + prompts + generate_audio=false). No Chatterbox voice render is required; the voice binding reuses phase_05_voices/kai_voice_audition.json.

why_not_forced: The only ways to break the cycle are (a) a phase-11 ordering machinery change (e.g., let write_voice_handoff_plan accept a deterministically-precomputed request_body_sha256, or let the payload binding be seeded before the compiled canonical for voiced runs), or (b) fabricating a transient stub phase11_live_request.v1.json to seed a fixpoint (compute the deterministic request_body_sha256 -> stub canonical -> write_voice_handoff_plan -> bootstrap binding -> real compile overwrites the stub -> regenerate the plan/binding -> validate). Option (b) fabricates a provider-request artifact to satisfy a gate on the IRREVERSIBLE paid-submit path. Per 'factual blocked outcome beats forced pass', neither the machinery change nor the fabricated-stub fixpoint was performed unilaterally on the paid boundary. The certified state (index b4655635, rung v6, activation) is untouched by this decision; phase-11 request-scoped artifacts are not in the hash-bound index.
next_required_action: Human/upstream decision on the voiced-run phase-11 ordering. Recommended: a small machinery fix so voiced runs can seed the payload binding for a NEAR_SILENT_VOICED/post_mux strategy without a pre-existing compiled canonical -- e.g., add a --request-body-sha256 option to write_voice_handoff_plan (bound later by validate against the compiled canonical), or a compile pre-pass that emits the deterministic request_body_sha256 for the voice plan. Then the linear chain proceeds: write_voice_handoff_plan -> bootstrap-phase11-payload-binding (audio gate passes) -> capture-provider-source-snapshot -> capture-public-media-evidence -> compile-phase11-canonical-live-request -> validate -> phase11-fal-canary-preflight -> write-phase11-approval-receipts (verbatim operator text + request_body_sha256 + max spend $10 + attempt budget 1) -> phase11-fal-canary-execute (the single paid submit).
